items.question: What graduated sequence of thickness must the threaded elements follow?
premises: The first element in the sequence is thick.
The next element is smaller than that preceding one.
The following element is smaller still, continuing in the same manner.
items.inference: The threaded elements must be arranged in a progressively diminishing order of thickness.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the elements depends on the preceding verses describing the threading.
items.plain_english: The first should be thick, then one smaller than that, then one smaller still, and so on in the same way.
